title: Repository-native PMS
context: PMS must preserve project knowledge across agents without an external service dependency.
problem: Choose v1 memory storage and tooling that remain portable, inspectable, and usable offline.
options_considered: Markdown, JSON, JSONL, Python, and Git in the repository.
External database, hosted memory service, or vector search.
decision: Use repository-native Markdown, JSON, JSONL, Python, and Git exclusively for PMS v1. External storage and semantic search are not v1 dependencies.
rationale: These formats are human-readable, versionable, low-cost, portable, and available without a network service.
consequences: Records and validation live in the repository.
Users remain responsible for ordinary Git backup and review.
Search is local text search; no semantic retrieval is promised.
